chunks: Verily the promise made to you is true:
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the certainty of the promise of resurrection?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Adh-Dhariyat, this verse serves as a definitive rebuttal to the Meccan polytheists who dismissed the concept of bodily resurrection as mere myth. Shia exegetes, such as Allamah Tabatabai, emphasize that 'la-sadiq' (it is true) underscores the absolute certainty of divine justice, linking the promise of recompense directly to the reality of the Day of Judgment.
